mapper.insert: insert into export_job (job_id, request_id, export_type, file_format, query_snapshot, status, progress, total_rows, processed_rows, retry_count, next_retry_at, operator_id, create_time, update_time) values (#{jobId}, #{requestId}, #{exportType}, #{fileFormat}, #{querySnapshot}, #{status}, #{progress}, #{totalRows}, #{processedRows}, #{retryCount}, #{nextRetryAt}, #{operatorId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select * from export_job where operator_id = #{operatorId} and request_id = #{requestId}
select count(*) from export_job where operator_id = #{operatorId} and status in ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
mapper.update: update export_job set lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, update_time = #{now} where job_id = #{jobId} and status = 'RUNNING' and lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}

update export_job set status = 'CANCELED', lease_owner = null, lease_until = null, error_code = null, error_message = null, finished_at = #{now}, update_time = #{now} where job_id = #{jobId} and status in ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')

update export_job set status = 'PENDING', progress = 0, processed_rows = 0, retry_count = 0, next_retry_at = #{now}, lease_owner = null, lease_until = null, error_code = null, error_message = null, started_at = null, finished_at = null, update_time = #{now} where job_id = #{jobId} and status = 'FAILED'
mapper.select: select job_id from export_job where (status = 'SUCCEEDED' and expires_at <= #{now}) or (status = 'EXPIRED' and file_path is not null) order by expires_at, job_id limit #{limit}
select file_path from export_job where file_path is not null and status = 'SUCCEEDED'
mapper.update: update export_job set status = 'EXPIRED', update_time = #{now} where job_id = #{jobId} and status = 'SUCCEEDED' and expires_at <= #{now}
update export_job set file_path = null, update_time = #{now} where job_id = #{jobId} and status = 'EXPIRED'
mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(case when status = 'PENDING' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as pending, coalesce(sum(case when status = 'RUNNING' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as running, coalesce(sum(case when status = 'SUCCEEDED' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as succeeded, coalesce(sum(case when status = 'FAILED' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as failed, coalesce(sum(case when status = 'CANCELED' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as canceled, coalesce(sum(case when status = 'EXPIRED' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as expired, coalesce(sum(case when status = 'RUNNING' and lease_until <= #{now} then 1 else 0 end), 0) as expired_leases, case when sum(case when status in ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED') then 1 else 0 end) = 0 then 0 else round(100 * sum(case when status = 'SUCCEEDED' then 1 else 0 end) / sum(case when status in ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED') then 1 else 0 end), 2) end as success_rate, (select f.job_id from export_job f where f.status = 'FAILED' order by f.finished_at desc, f.job_id desc limit 1) as recent_failure_job_id, (select f.export_type from export_job f where f.status = 'FAILED' order by f.finished_at desc, f.job_id desc limit 1) as recent_failure_type, (select f.error_code from export_job f where f.status = 'FAILED' order by f.finished_at desc, f.job_id desc limit 1) as recent_failure_error_code, (select f.finished_at from export_job f where f.status = 'FAILED' order by f.finished_at desc, f.job_id desc limit 1) as recent_failure_time from export_job
select count(*) from export_job where status = 'FAILED'
select count(*) from export_job where status = 'RUNNING' and lease_until <= #{now}
